dogecoin.text: 🏦 Abu Dhabi's financial hub ADGM teams up with Chainlink! With a MoU signed, they aim to bridge traditional finance to blockchain. 🚀 Trump's media targets crypto ETFs, Dogecoin forms 10M DOGE reserve, and Polymarket adds Solana for deposits. Bullish trends ahead! 📈
